headline: Colonial Thrusts Reshape Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy
war_summary: Since the prior dispatch, fresh Colonial gains have unsettled the northern and central theaters. Along the blood-drenched Nevish Line, Colonial forces secured a third strategic base against five Warden strongholds, logging six further base transitions over the past two hours amid severe fighting around Blackcoat Way and Grief Mother. In Linn of Mercy, Colonial troops reversed recent Warden counter-strokes to claim nine bastions, reducing the Warden presence to a solitary redoubt alongside one neutral ruin as casualty rates began to cool. Weathered Expanse maintained its six-to-one Warden advantage with two unoccupied sites, sustaining three base contests at Crow’s Nest and Wightwalk. To the east, Marban Hollow saw two rapid transfers at Checkpoint Bua, dividing the sector evenly with three bases apiece and two contested gaps. In Stlican Shelf, Warden forces lost their remaining foothold following two recent actions near Briar, ceding the territory to eight Colonial bases and one vacant post. Farther west, Kuura Strand remains quiet with five Colonial holds and one ruined enclave, while Callahan’s Passage absorbed steepening butcher bills along an otherwise unyielding front.
